note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative (jurisdiction unspecified). The tag holds the stated difference exactly as supplied; the substitution swaps one supplied datum for the alternative value and only redraws its dependent geometry (the ◆ level, the band, the bracket and the tokens between the levels). Nothing is computed, valued or owed; no damages, compensation, liability, fault or causation conclusion is drawn. Long-labels-stress: coordinator decision (standing stress-cap rule, docs/AUTHORING.md item 20, from LAW-0687/0689–0692; subject floor: 'Subject ≥ 0.20 of the frame height at rest and hold (causation-05 LAW-0700 decision)', production/SESSION_HANDOFF.md). True driver: the 1:1 box (the balance column at rest must reach 0.20 of the frame height). After trying the fallback layouts (context over the record and band; record and band side by side under the context; context beside the record with the band in a column), five record entries left the 1:1 column at 0.180. Measured, rendered at 1080p (2026-09-27): five entries → 1:1 17.0 px, column 0.180 of the frame height; 16:9 23.0 px / 0.264; 9:16 22.0 px / 0.264. The stress keeps every text at its near-maximum length and caps the entry COUNT at four (baseline 3; the link after the last entry drops with it); after the cap: 1:1 18.0 px / 0.213; 16:9 25.0 px / 0.264; 9:16 22.0 px / 0.293. Every field stays longer than the baseline and every count ≥ the baseline.
